sources.title: Attunement sign-in gate key art
sources.origin: Owner-supplied 880x495 login-screen reference image (2026-11-20). Derivative: baked-in form, link and footer text painted out (OpenCV FSR/Telea inpainting), upscaled 4x locally with ESRGAN (UpscalerJS esrgan-thick), border-trimmed and exported as 2560x1440 WebP. The live HTML form is laid over the painted-out area.
owner_decisions: 2026-11-20: owner directed that this image replace the current login screen, upscaled where needed.
sources.license: owner-authorised; provider licence not independently verified
sources.provider_terms: Not recorded. The owner supplied the image; the tool or service that produced it was not stated.
sources.attribution: Attunement key art supplied by the owner. Credited in docs/ASSETS.md.
